title: MetaHackers
tagline: Manage your social contacts' key shards in MetaMask a MetaMask Snap!
description: Key management social recovery solutions, as used by AirGap and Argent, rely on people having a secure and safe place to save their social contacts' secret share key shards. This Snap uses the convenience and security of MetaMask to store and retrieve these secret share key shards.
how_its_made: This is made using MetaMask Snaps: https://docs.metamask.io/guide/snaps.html. This Snap uses the entropy for Garlicoin to encrypt the user's key shards.
